# rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry-otel

OpenTelemetry traces backend for `rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry`. Adapts the core
`Tracer` facade onto the OTel SDK, exports OTLP, PSR-15 root-span middleware,
W3C propagation. Namespace `Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel`.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry-otel guzzlehttp/guzzle
```

Needs a PSR-18 client (guzzle) for OTLP export.

## Rules

- Installing this package binds the swappable core `TracerProviderInterface =>
  OtelTracerProvider`. Do NOT also bind it (or `Tracer`/core `TracerInterface`)
  in the app — `yiisoft/config` `Duplicate key`.
- Frozen `trace()` contract (from core): success keeps status Unset (never Ok);
  exception → recordException + status Error + end + rethrow; nested inherits
  parent traceId; `end()`/detach in `finally` (anti-leak). Flush is separate
  (`SpanFlusher`), never per request.
- Attribute keys are stable OTel semconv string literals (no sem-conv dep).
- Env: `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`.

## API

### Provider / tracer (core-facing)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\{OtelTracerProvider, OtelTracerProviderFactory, OtlpExporterFactory};

$exporter    = (new OtlpExporterFactory())->create('http://collector:4318'); // OTLP/HTTP
$sdkProvider = (new OtelTracerProviderFactory(serviceName: 'app', batch: true))->create($exporter);
$tracer      = (new OtelTracerProvider($sdkProvider))->getTracer();           // core TracerInterface

$tracer->trace('op', static fn ($span) => $span->setAttribute('k', 'v'));
```

`OtelTracerProviderFactory::create(SpanExporterInterface)` — batch processor by
default; `batch: false` = SimpleSpanProcessor (immediate, for tests).
`OtlpExporterFactory::create(string $endpoint = 'http://localhost:4318', string $contentType = 'application/x-protobuf')`.

### Middleware (PSR-15)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\{OtelMiddleware, TraceContextExtractor};

$mw = new OtelMiddleware($tracer, new TraceContextExtractor());
// opens a SERVER span "METHOD /path", extracts incoming traceparent, sets
// http.* attributes, marks 5xx as Error, ends span + detaches scope in finally.
```

### Propagation

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\{TraceContextExtractor, TraceContextInjector};

$otelContext = (new TraceContextExtractor())->extract($serverRequest); // OTel ContextInterface (activate it)
$request     = (new TraceContextInjector())->inject($clientRequest);   // adds traceparent from active span
```

### Flush (long-running)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\SpanFlusher;

(new SpanFlusher($sdkProvider))->flush(); // forceFlush(); call on worker stop / timer, not per request
```

### Testing

Use `OpenTelemetry\SDK\Trace\SpanExporter\InMemoryExporter` + `batch: false`, then
assert `$exporter->getSpans()[0]` fields (getName/getKind/getStatus/getAttributes/
getEvents/getResource).
